name: Soma Papers & Industries Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1991, Soma Paper and Industries Ltd is in the business of Coated Papers[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
SPIL is a premier coated paper manufacturing company in India. It started with china clay coated paper and added on to its product range, carbonless (self-copy) papers, fluorescent (coloured) papers, and other speciality papers. All these products are marketed under the brand name Diamond CoteTM through dealers / distributors all over the country

pros: Stock is trading at 0.47 times its book value
cons: Promoter holding has decreased over last quarter: -48.9%
Company has a low return on equity of -80.2% over last 3 years.
